name: cancelling_a_rejected_request_to_get_the
use_case: Change or cancel a leave request
branch: An employee attempts to cancel an already rejected leave request to reclaim days, but rejected requests cannot be cancelled and days were never deducted.
tests: Checks request status REQ-1107 and balance BAL-E12-ANN, explaining that rejected requests cannot be cancelled and no days were deducted.
instruction:
You submitted an annual leave request REQ-1107 for 28 to 31 December 2026 that was rejected. You want to cancel this rejected request so that you can get the 4 annual leave days back into your leave balance.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E12
- Name: Laura Croft
- Request ID: REQ-1107
- Leave type: annual

persona.name: Laura Croft
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'd like to cancel my rejected annual leave request REQ-1107 so that those 4 days are added back to my available annual leave balance.
